caption: The drawing depicts a single wooden rocking chair, positioned at an angle facing toward the right. The chair is rendered in shades of brown, suggesting a polished wood surface. The legs of the chair are connected by horizontal rods, with the bottom of each leg attached to two long, curved rockers that enable the rocking motion. The armrests are smoothly curved and supported by vertical posts. The seat is wide and slightly contoured, and the high backrest features ornate, carved floral patterns concentrated in the upright back slat and the crest rail at the top. The background is plain and light, with no additional objects or decorations present.
title: Boston Rocker
